title: Curate
tagline: Mint your favorite music genres at random from curated limited time only crates.
description:
Curate provides a platform for artists to experiment with new and exciting ways to create and share their work. We provide a way for artists to monetize their work in a new and innovative way allowing them to retain full control over their work and how it is distributed. 

Unlike other NFT Marketplaces, we do not function as a popularity contest where top sellers are pushed and showcased at the front of the line. Our genre-specific crates are stocked with music NFTs from musicians at all levels in their Web3 journey. That means every artist has the opportunity to sell their collection out and gain a new fan base.
how_its_made:
Moralis and moralisUIkit were used for the front end.
Zora Creator Contracts were used to create proxy contracts for each of our collections/crates.

Lastly, NFT.storage was used for storing all of the mp3s, images, and meta.
We would like to launch on polygon as soon as Zora Creator launches the creator contract on poly.
